summary: The revised obligation map accurately distinguishes the inspected numerical domains and assurance levels. Representative Q8 denominators and residual targets agree across receipts; the size15 trees have the promised fresh target and degree caps; the D16 receipts preserve all eight deletion models and consistent fibre masses. No substantive source-mapping defect was found in this bounded review. Complete independent replay remains outside this round's checks.

findings.statement: The inspected Q8 coefficient replays reconstruct the same hashed producer build, while the size15 tree replayer independently reconstructs literal finite sets. These are materially different verification boundaries.
findings.disposition: The revised manuscript and source map preserve this distinction. Source inspection supports the stated independence boundary, without certifying every model row or rerunning every finite predicate.

revisions.action: Inspected the representative Q8 replay source identity and the complete size15 literal-set tree checker, and rechecked Sections 3.1 and 7 of the revised manuscript.
revisions.result: Shared-producer reconstruction is explicitly disclosed; the independent tree checker imports only standard-library modules and independently defines its literal sunflower predicate, candidate domain and scope checks. The earlier assurance qualification is retained rather than promoted to whole-proof certification.
